purpose: Define optional per-resource/per-operation reauthentication requirements using exact required assurance level, allowed authentication methods and validity lifetime.

topics.name: Resource Reauthentication Requirement
topics.purpose: Define optional per-resource/per-operation reauthentication requirements using exact required assurance level, allowed authentication methods and validity lifetime.

semantics.identity_rule: Each reusable reauth requirement/profile has an explicit identity.
semantics.assurance_rule: Required IAM assurance level is explicit.
semantics.lifetime_rule: Reauth validity lifetime is explicit and resource/profile-specific.
semantics.session_rule: Existing session assurance may satisfy requirement only if valid under the exact profile.
semantics.authorization_rule: Reauth satisfaction is an additional gate and does not replace AccessCore authorization.

invariants.rule: Identity, authentication assurance, authorization policy, authorization decision, delegation and runtime execution remain separate machine-significant identities/evidence; no one layer silently substitutes for another.

Ambiguous, missing, stale or unverifiable authority for a protected effect fails closed rather than inheriting trust from locality, transport reachability, process ownership, UI visibility or previous success.

hard_gates.condition: same reauth reused for incompatible resource profile
